Definition: Telem, the name of a place in Idumaea, also of a temple doorkeeper
BiblicalUsage: Telem is the name of a town in the south of Judah, and of a doorkeeper of the temple. The town is named among the cities of Judah toward the coast, and the doorkeeper is named among those who had taken strange wives and put them away in the days of Ezra.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the town and the doorkeeper share a name, and both stand in the record of the people coming home.
